items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I think I insisted on this particular tune of Charlie Christians... Boy that man was mmh, incredibly out of this world.

ctx.x: Did a recording session allow you to talk things over more than a club date?

It was really a computerized thing in your brain, man... No, ... You just I had to remember it. Here was a guy who was blind & he remembers it, you better get on your toes... I think I insisted on this particular tune of Charlie Christians... All these riffs are talked over... Boy that man was mmh, incredibly out of this world. Play boogie woogie, do anything...
So that went over pretty good [listening to the recording] Now was back there I made a modernized riff...
